llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了热处理对激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V力学性能和生物相容性的影响，直接对应后处理调控方向。
llm.why_not_core: The paper covers both biocompatibility and mechanical performance, but does not specifically isolate fatigue life improvement as the primary metric.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过热处理改善LPBF Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能与生物相容性，以满足植入物要求。
summary_zh.method: 对LPBF成型的Ti-6Al-4V进行不同热处理，分析微观结构与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著提升了材料的强度、延展性和生物相容性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试、硬度测试和细胞毒性实验验证性能改进。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance both mechanical performance and biocompatibility of laser powder bed fused Ti-6Al-4V through optimized heat treatment for implant applications.
summary_en.method: Various heat treatment cycles were applied to LPBF Ti-6Al-4V, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment improved tensile strength, ductility, and biocompatibility compared to as-built condition.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile, hardness) and in vitro cytotoxicity assays were conducted to validate the improvements.

papers.title: Evaluation of Mechanical, Corrosion, and Wear Properties of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo Welded by Nd:YAG Laser, pp. 173-180
papers.abstract: This study investigates the mechanical, tribological, and electrochemical corrosion properties of Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64) and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo (Ti6242) alloys welded using Nd:YAG laser welding, with a specific focus on aerospace applications.The research systematically evaluates tensile strength to assess weld integrity, pin-on-disc wear tests to analyze tribological performance, and electrochemical corrosion tests to determine resistance in aggressive environments.The influence of key laser welding parameters, including laser power, welding speed, and focal position, on weld bead geometry and performance was examined.The experimental results indicate that bead width varies between 3.46 mm and 3.92 mm, with laser power playing a significant role, while the depth of penetration remains consistent at approximately 2.21-2.23 mm.Wear analysis reveals that wear rate increases with applied load, sliding velocity, and.Electrochemical corrosion studies indicate significant variations in corrosion resistance among the welded samples, with the lowest corrosion rate (0.00036 mmpy) observed in EX2 and the highest (0.00354 mmpy) in EX4.The findings establish a correlation between tribological and electrochemical behavior, emphasizing the necessity of optimizing laser welding parameters to enhance durability and performance in aerospace applications.This study provides valuable insights into the interplay of wear and corrosion in laserwelded titanium alloys, contributing to the advancement of highperformance welding techniques.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是激光焊接而非增材制造，与Ti-6Al-4V增材制造的机械与疲劳性能无关
llm.why_not_core: The paper investigates laser welding of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti6242, not additive manufacturing; it lacks any AM process such as LPBF, SLM, EBM, or DED, and does not address mechanical/fatigue properties of AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光焊接钛合金的机械、磨损和腐蚀性能以优化航空航天应用
summary_zh.method: 用Nd:YAG激光焊接Ti-6Al-4V和Ti6242，进行拉伸、磨损和电化学腐蚀测试
summary_zh.result: 焊接参数影响焊缝几何和性能，磨损率随载荷和速度增加，腐蚀速率在0.00036-0.00354 mmpy之间
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量拉伸强度、磨损率和腐蚀速率验证

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to evaluate the mechanical, tribological, and corrosion properties of laser-welded Ti-6Al-4V and Ti6242 alloys for aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: Nd:YAG laser welding was performed on Ti-6Al-4V and Ti6242, followed by tensile, pin-on-disc wear, and electrochemical corrosion tests.
summary_en.result: Bead width varied with laser power while penetration depth remained constant; wear rate increased with load and sliding speed, and corrosion rates ranged from 0.00036 to 0.00354 mmpy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental data from mechanical, wear, and corrosion tests were used to validate the effects of welding parameters.
